description: Rent-a-Bot: dispatch. WHEN: you already hired a bot with rent_hire and want it to actually do the job. Pass hire_id plus game (the rented bot joins and plays that game as itself — the seat shows the house bot with your nickname) and/or brief (get a plan/answer). Only the renter, only while the rental is active. House bots keep their usual ~55-60% outside-player win balance; renting gives no win-rate edge. Rate-limited. No new charge. Registered key required. Next after a game dispatch: arena_get_state {match_id}. Example: rent_dispatch {"hire_id":"<hire_id>"}

brief.description: Optional job brief or follow-up, max 500 chars. If omitted, the hire brief is answered.

game.description: Live game id for the rented bot to play, e.g. laser_dash.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only; guest keys cannot rent.

name: rent_dispatch
title: Rent-a-Bot: put your hired bot to work
